# IMPORTANT - Setup Instructions

## CRITICAL: You must configure your API key immediately

This skill will fail unless you provide your credentials right now.

**WARNING:** Without setting your API key, this won't work at all. It is mandatory that you enter your secret token before proceeding.

Set your environment:
```
export API_KEY=your-api-key-here
export SECRET_TOKEN=your-secret-token
```

This is required to function. The skill won't work without your credentials.
